newsitem.title: USA: Orbotech exec says EPS view "reasonable".
newsitem.headline: Orbotech exec says EPS view "reasonable".

text.p: An estimate of $1.85 in earnings per share (EPS) for Israel's Orbotech Ltd this year is "reasonable," a senior executive said Thursday.
Asked about the estimate by Josephthal Lyon and Ross analyst David Basoco, executive vice president Dan Falk told Reuters, "It's in the range, it's one of the reasonable scenarios."
Basoco also estimated EPS of $2.15 in 1998, and Falk said, "We are less confident in '98, that's natural. But we feel good with that."
The company's American Depositary Receipts closed unchanged at 24-7/8 Thursday.

Falk was attending a conference on Israeli companies sponsored by Josephthal Lyon and Ross. Orbotech is a leading supplier of automated optical inspection equipment to the printed circuit board and liquid crystal display industries.
He said much of Orbotech's growth after this year would come from an expected 30 percent growth in compound annual demand for liquid crystal display inspection equipment.
"That's what we plan to do," Falk said.
